brief:
A video posted on social media by an Egyptian user showing an EgyptAir aircraft parked alongside an Israeli plane at an Italian airport, Shehab Wire reported. The clip was accompanied by audio commentary that triggered widespread reaction in Israeli circles, according to the report.

The footage appears to have been filmed at an airport terminal, capturing the two commercial aircraft in close proximity. The post prompted significant discussion in Israeli media and online spaces, though details of the specific audio content and the exact nature of reactions remain unclear from available reports.

title: Egyptian man's video of planes sparks Israeli controversy
